system.description:
You have a talent for knowing when things are not as they should be, whether through a feeling in the pit of your gut or tested observation. It is useful for sensing when other supernatural creatures are about, detecting Numina or strange phenomena, or catching that weird feeling when the laws of nature are about to take a hard left.

Awareness requires a Mental Challenge to use, and retests are made with the Occult Ability.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
